arrays.title: Range sum queries (prefix sums)
arrays.statement: Answer many queries sum(l, r) quickly.
arrays.solution:
def build(a):
     pre = [0]
     for x in a: pre.append(pre[-1] + x)
     return pre


def range_sum(pre, l, r):                # inclusive, 0-based
     return pre[r + 1] - pre[l]


pre = build([2, 4, 5, 7, 1])
print(range_sum(pre, 1, 3))              # 16

arrays.title: Transpose a matrix
arrays.solution:
def transpose(m):
     r, c = len(m), len(m[0])
     return [[m[i][j] for i in range(r)] for j in range(c)]
# [[1,2,3],[4,5,6]] -> [[1,4],[2,5],[3,6]]

linked-lists.title: Delete the n-th node from the end
linked-lists.solution:
def remove_nth_from_end(head, n):
     dummy = Node(0, head)
     fast = slow = dummy
     for _ in range(n): fast = fast.next
     while fast.next:
         fast = fast.next; slow = slow.next
     slow.next = slow.next.next
     return dummy.next

linked-lists.title: Reverse a linked list
Middle of the list
Detect a cycle (Floyd)
Merge two sorted lists
linked-lists.solution:
def merge(a, b):
     dummy = tail = Node(0)
     while a and b:
          if a.data <= b.data: tail.next, a = a, a.next
          else: tail.next, b = b, b.next
          tail = tail.next
     tail.next = a or b
     return dummy.next

queues.title: Queue using two stacks
Circular queue
Josephus problem
queues.statement: n people stand in a circle; every k-th is eliminated. Return the survivor (1- based).
queues.solution:
from collections import deque
def josephus(n, k):
    q = deque(range(1, n + 1))
    while len(q) > 1:
         q.rotate(-(k - 1))
         q.popleft()
    return q[0]

queues.title: Binary numbers from 1 to n using a queue
queues.solution:
from collections import deque
def gen_binary(n):
    q, out = deque(['1']), []
    for _ in range(n):
         s = q.popleft(); out.append(s)
         q.append(s + '0'); q.append(s + '1')
    return out

trees.title: k-th smallest in a BST
trees.solution:
def kth_smallest(r, k):
        st, cur = [], r
        while True:
            while cur: st.append(cur); cur = cur.left
            cur = st.pop(); k -= 1
            if k == 0: return cur.val
            cur = cur.right
